title: Commercial Roofing in Edinburg, TX | Edel Roofing & Construction
description: Commercial roofing in Edinburg, TX: flat roofs, TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen and repairs. Licensed RCAT #03-0489. Free estimate: (956) 422-3335.
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction installs and repairs commercial roofs in Edinburg for business owners, property managers and building owners. We're licensed, bonded and insured, and the estimate is free with no obligation.

sections.title: Commercial roofing contractor serving Edinburg
paras: Our office is in Edinburg, and we've worked on commercial buildings across Hidalgo County since 2003. We install and repair flat and low slope roofs on strip malls, offices, warehouses, churches, medical buildings and apartment complexes. If your building is in Edinburg, we're close by and can get there quickly.

A commercial roof is a different job from a house. The roof is bigger, the materials are different, and one bad leak can close your doors for the day. So the order stays the same every time: we inspect first, then you get a written estimate before any work starts.

cards.title: Flat Roof Installation
cards.body: New flat and low slope roofs for commercial buildings. We install TPO, EPDM and modified bitumen, the three systems you see most on South Texas commercial buildings.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Replacement
cards.body: When the old roof is worn out, we tear it off, check the decking underneath, and install a new commercial roof.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Repairs
cards.body: Leaks, membrane patches, flashing and drain problems. We look for what caused the damage and fix that too, so the same leak doesn't come back.

cards.title: Roof Coatings
cards.body: A reflective coating goes over the roof you already have. It extends the life of the roof and cuts the heat the roof soaks up. It costs less than a new roof when the system underneath is still sound but starting to wear.

cards.title: Storm & Hail Damage
cards.body: Hidalgo County storms can do real damage to a commercial roof. We check for hail, impact damage and wind uplift, and we can help you understand what your policy covers before you file a claim.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Inspections
cards.body: Regular inspections catch small problems while they are still cheap to fix. They help property managers, anyone buying a building, or an owner who just wants to know what shape the roof is in.

sections.title: Commercial roofing in Edinburg: what we see most
paras: Edinburg has all kinds of commercial buildings: strip centers along Closner and McColl, warehouses near the Edinburg industrial areas, medical and professional offices near DHR Health, UTRGV campus buildings, and churches all over town. Most of them have flat or low slope roofs.

What wears out a commercial roof in Edinburg is what wears them out all over the Valley: hard heat, strong sun, and now and then a bad hailstorm. Flat roofs also hold water after a heavy rain when the drains are clogged or the roof doesn't have enough slope. We check the drainage on every commercial roof we look at.

If you manage several properties in Edinburg or Hidalgo County, we can put them on a regular inspection schedule. You catch problems early instead of calling us for an emergency repair in the middle of a business day.

faqs.q: What types of commercial roofs do you install in Edinburg?
faqs.a: We install TPO, EPDM and modified bitumen, the most common flat and low slope systems in South Texas. We also apply roof coatings when a building needs more life out of its roof without a full replacement. We'll tell you which system fits your building, the size of the roof and your budget.

faqs.q: How long does a commercial roof last in the Rio Grande Valley?
faqs.a: A commercial membrane that's installed right usually lasts 15 to 25 years here, depending on the material and how well it's kept up. Our heat and sun wear a roof out faster than in cooler places. Regular inspections find small problems before they cut years off the roof.

faqs.q: Do you work with property managers and building owners too?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with property managers who look after several buildings and with owners who lease space to tenants. We can schedule around your tenants, give you paperwork for insurance and maintenance records, and set up inspections on a regular schedule.

faqs.q: Can you help with an insurance claim for hail or storm damage to a commercial roof?
faqs.a: We inspect the damage and give you a written report of what we found. That report helps when you file a claim. We are not a public adjuster. What we can do is go over what we saw with you, so you know what to bring up with your insurance company.

faqs.q: How do I get a commercial roofing estimate in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Call us at (956) 422-3335 or book online. We set a time to walk the roof and measure it, then give you a written estimate. Commercial estimates are free, with no obligation.
